governance_basis.fact: M2 is not met; an independent labeled holdout and accuracy/performance evidence are still required.
No independent blinded real-source labels are recorded; precision and recall are not estimable.
D41 froze detector 0.17.0 and is not current-version accuracy evidence.
D41's 99-case packet was post-scan stratified and has zero independent labels; it is not a population accuracy sample.
D48 is a convenience source sample; its 97 files were partial, scan was blocked, and no labels are available.
These are component/CVE replay evidence with partial coverage, not independently sampled and labeled holdout data.
Pasteboard records are targeted source/config investigations; D53 source/config correlation does not establish a built product.

known_cve_universe.primary_advisory_manifest: required_per_identifier; publisher, canonical URL, retrieval date, immutable saved bytes SHA-256, affected/fixed version scope
known_cve_universe.generalization_claim: within this fixed catalog only; not discovery of novel CVEs

sampling.minimums_rationale: administrative workload floors against a tiny pilot; repository clustering can make effective sample much smaller than file count
sampling.planning_formula: n_eff >= z_0.975^2 * p * (1-p) / h^2; n_raw >= n_eff * DEFF / (1-r)
planning_formula_inputs: approved targets and interval half-width h
plausible precision/recall/prevalence ranges from data outside D55
sampling.recall_positive_count_planning_requires: positive prevalence and sampling fractions to estimate required repository/source scope
sampling.required_pre_label_design_simulation: simulate registered stratified repository selection and cluster bootstrap; freeze inputs/output before scan or labels
sampling.missing_input_or_insufficient_power_acti: remain not_ready; expand or redesign before scanning
sampling.required_pre_label_planning: freeze design-based precision planning simulation using sampling frame, cluster-size distribution, and plausible prevalence range; grow cohort before scan/label access if it cannot support target interval widths
sampling.final_sufficiency_depends_on: observed cluster-aware intervals, effective sample size, and pre-registered thresholds
sampling.if_frame_or_independence_unavailable: stop_not_ready; do not substitute D41, D48, D49-D53, prior D development, or synthetic cases

source_identity_and_deduplication.submodules: include only exact pinned gitlink commit/tree with frozen recursive manifest; unavailable gitlink is explicit unavailable scope and may fail coverage gate
source_identity_and_deduplication.symlinks: record mode 120000, link blob, literal target; do not follow absolute/broken/cyclic/out-of-tree targets; in-tree aliases map to one canonical target file
source_identity_and_deduplication.development_overlap: identical raw blob SHA-256 across any repo/path/commit excludes that source unit from D55
source_identity_and_deduplication.within_holdout_cross_repo_same_blob: one canonical source-content unit; deterministic owner is lexicographically smallest repo/commit/path in complete pre-scan frame; only owner row is eligible for selection and aliases are not independent sample units
source_identity_and_deduplication.vendor_copies: exact copies use blob grouping; modified vendor copies require provenance/content comparison; confirmed derivatives share overlap group; unresolved derivative status blocks source before scan
source_identity_and_deduplication.canonical_content_key: raw file bytes SHA-256 plus language/path-policy class, with repo/tree/path retained as context
source_identity_and_deduplication.unresolved_identity_action: pending and stop affected stratum; do not score

freeze_requirements: repository commit/tree and eligible scope hashes
runtime environment and replay driver hash

finding_matching.match_rule: same snapshot and exact normalized root cause, or overlapping spans in same function with reviewer-confirmed same condition/trigger
finding_matching.sensitive_exposure_identity: source object, sensitive datum, sink operation, function/path, trigger
finding_matching.known_cve_identity: CVE ID, vulnerable package/source instance, affected version condition, root-cause unit
finding_matching.ambiguous_mapping: unknown_match; separately counted and excluded until adjudicated blind

coverage_and_unknown_aggregation.threshold_failure_action: stop_population_claim; retain counts; primary metrics not_estimable for target population; subgroup descriptive only

metric_denominators.precision: TP / (TP + FP) among adjudicable frozen scanner findings; show unknown candidate count/rate and adjudicable fraction
metric_denominators.recall: TP / (TP + FN) over all independently identified adjudicated supported_risk units in exhaustively reviewed scope, or a valid preregistered probability sample with design weights
metric_denominators.unknown: reported separately; never silently assigned to TP, FP, FN, or TN
metric_denominators.unknown_sensitivity: precision: unknown candidates and matches as FP; recall: unknown references and matches as missed positives (FN); ambiguous candidate never TP
metric_denominators.interval_design: stratified repository-cluster bootstrap, design-weighted Hájek ratio, 10,000 replicates, PCG64 seed frozen before labels, percentile 2.5/97.5 bounds
metric_denominators.design_effect: bootstrap variance under stratified cluster design divided by variance under file/finding-level SRS resampling of same weighted records; report DEFF and n_eff=n/DEFF
metric_denominators.invalid_interval: more than 5 percent bootstrap replicates with zero or undefined denominator => not_estimable
metric_denominators.small_cluster_rule: fewer than 8 repositories in any contributing stratum or fewer than 20 total clusters => no inferential CI; 8-19 clusters descriptive/inconclusive with leave-one-repository-out sensitivity
metric_denominators.sufficiency: at least 20 clusters, required lower bounds met, and each 95 percent CI half-width <=0.10; planning floor alone does not guarantee sufficiency

hard_stop_conditions: No auditable independent sampling frame or source-independence evidence
Source commit/tree/scope/blob identity cannot be verified
Scanner is dirty or detector/model/profile/parser/scope hashes are missing or changed after freeze
Selection, exclusions, inclusion probabilities, or seed are missing or influenced by scan output
Fewer than two independent qualified reviewers, prediction disclosure before label freeze, or incomplete review for recall
Missing original label files, adjudication record, source-bound evidence, or hash-frozen analysis inputs
Coverage fails 90 percent complete, 5 percent maximum not-run plus failed, or 10 percent maximum source-unit unknown gate
Any stratum has fewer than 8 repo clusters or track has fewer than 20 clusters for inferential claims
Bootstrap has over 5 percent undefined-denominator replicates
Known-CVE advisory evidence manifest or frozen finding matcher is incomplete
Partial or not-run coverage prevents the particular claim from being judged
Minimum cohort floors not met; stop population claim and report descriptive pilot only
Source/output mutated or reproducibility cannot be reconstructed
m2_exit_criteria: Independent and provenance-bound cohort selected using the preregistered auditable design
Scanner bundle frozen before scan and labels
Two independent blind labels per unit plus independent adjudication of disagreements/metric-relevant unknowns
Exhaustive prediction-blind miss review or valid weighted probability design for recall
Track-specific TP/FP/FN/unknown, precision/recall denominators and intervals, coverage, runtime, and peak RSS reported
Reproducible raw artifacts and hash-verifying scoring code
D owner review of limitations and readiness evidence
each track passes preregistered lower-bound and interval-width thresholds or remains explicitly inconclusive
current_missing_inputs: independent source inventory and frozen sampling frame
prior-use overlap ledger and eligible cohort with verified identities
pre-scan selection record, inclusion probabilities, and seed record
frozen scanner and model/profile/parser/configuration hashes for the target evaluation version
pre-label precision planning simulation and frozen sufficiency decision
primary advisory source snapshots and SHA-256 for every known-CVE catalog identifier
frozen coverage/unknown aggregation implementation and stop report
two qualified independent reviewers and conflict declarations
approved immutable storage for sealed predictions and separated labels
current_stop_decision: stop_before_source_selection_and_scan_until_missing_inputs_are_provided_and_frozen; known-CVE track additionally blocked on primary advisory hash manifest
scope_limit: Source-level holdout evidence cannot establish product applicability or satisfy M3 by itself.
